title: CODATA 2022: the vacuum electric permittivity is 8.854 187 8188 × 10⁻¹² F/m
summary: The standard uncertainty is 0.000 000 0014 × 10⁻¹² F/m. It is not marked exact.
body: The NIST 2022 listing prints 'vacuum electric permittivity 8.854 187 8188 e-12' with standard uncertainty '0.000 000 0014 e-12', unit F m⁻¹. It is not marked exact. It is not one of BIPM's seven defining constants.
